links.comparator_used: Baseline end-to-end system (system 1) with a single generated output per recording, without evidence capture or consensus voting
links.outcome: Robustness (variability of EMR quality scores) across specialties; medical accuracy and consistency
links.effect: Standard deviation reductions of 33.8% (periodontics), 55.9% (orthodontics), and 42.6% (prosthodontics), with the largest gains in complex prosthodontic cases
links.quote: System 2 improved robustness with standard deviation reductions of 33.8% (periodontics), 55.9% (orthodontics), and 42.6% (prosthodontics), with the largest gains in complex prosthodontic cases.

design_hint: evidence grounding and multi-version consensus voting added to baseline LLM documentation pipeline
